description: Screen a brand name against the USPTO federal register. Read-only. Use this FIRST for any name. Returns JSON with a plain-English risk verdict (HIGH / MEDIUM-HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW), ranked conflicting marks (each with sound/appearance similarity, class relatedness, live/dead status, owner, serial), and the data-as-of date. Pass format "csv" to get the same results as a spreadsheet (one row per hit) instead of JSON. Limited to 100 screens/day on this server. SCREEN ONLY — not a clearance opinion, not legal advice. After this, use check_global_marks for EU/UK, check_domains for the domain, and watch_mark to monitor the name.

classes.description: Nice classes (1-45) if you know them; otherwise inferred from goodsDescription

format.description: Response format: 'json' (default, full result) or 'csv' (same results as a spreadsheet — one row per hit, for saving or sharing)

goodsDescription.description: What you sell, e.g. 'music streaming app' or 'coffee shop'

includeDead.description: Also return dead/abandoned marks (lower risk, but useful context)

name: screen_trademark
